media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Connect Magnific, Higgsfield, or fal. The agent uses one set of tools; you choose the backends.
media.expert: Expose raw vendor MCP tools to agents
media.empty: No media provider connected. Connect one below to generate images, video, or upscales.
media.oauth.redirect: Continue in the browser to sign in, then return here.
media.compare.title: Which backend?
media.compare.lead: Connect the one that matches the job you actually have. A second backend is for a different kind of output — not a default double spend.
media.compare.magnific.bestFor: Photoreal stills; Creative or Precision upscale
media.compare.magnific.credits: Same pool as the website. Web Unlimited does not cover MCP/API.
media.compare.magnific.results: CDN URL — EYAS copies the file
media.compare.magnific.pickIf: You upscale, retouch, or need stills
media.compare.higgsfield.credits: MCP always spends credits, even on an unlimited web plan.
media.compare.higgsfield.results: URLs expire in about seven days — ingest is required
media.compare.higgsfield.pickIf: You need clips or a locked character
media.compare.fal.bestFor: Large model catalog; price check before a run
media.compare.fal.credits: MCP is free; you pay per model run.
media.compare.fal.pickIf: You want many models or a cost check first
media.compare.recommend.title: Recommendation
media.compare.recommend.1: Connect one backend for the job you have: stills/upscale → Magnific; video → Higgsfield; catalog/price → fal.
media.compare.recommend.2: Add a second backend when the kind changes. “Also run on” doubles credits — leave it empty unless you asked for a side-by-side.
media.compare.recommend.3: Leave raw vendor MCP tools off unless you are debugging. Images leave this machine for the vendor you connected.
